hypotheses: The production extraction probe fails because BSD tar lacks the required GNU options and identity.
The existing 12-segment skill path still exceeds Darwin PATH_MAX from a short temporary base.

extractionProbe.command: command -v zstd >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v cut >/dev/null 2>&1 && tar_version=$(tar --zstd --ignore-zeros --no-same-owner --same-permissions --delay-directory-restore --version 2>/dev/null) && case "$tar_version" in *"GNU tar"*) true ;; *) false ;; esac
